caption: The drawing shows an open umbrella with a wooden handle and a fabric canopy featuring a plaid pattern. The plaid consists of horizontal and vertical lines in shades of brown, beige, and light blue, forming a grid with squares and rectangles. The upper part of the umbrella's canopy displays a larger, tan and brown plaid, while the lower, frilled portion features a finer, densely patterned brown and blue plaid. The shaft of the umbrella is a light brown wood, and the handle, which is detached and laid below the shaft, is also wooden with a slightly curved shape and a metallic fitting at the connecting end. The background is plain, off-white.
title: Parasol
